subject: PO requirements, invoice consolidation and net terms for BlueWell engagement
messages:
From: Amy Lopez <amy.lopez@bluewellhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@bluewellhealth.com
Date: 2026-09-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO template + billing cadence for Redwood pilot

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and routing capabilities. Procurement asked me to confirm a few items before we can generate a firm PO:

- PO header fields: our ERP needs a PO Number, PO Date, Ship-to (we'll use the main billing address), and the Redwood invoice remit address. Do you require any additional PO-level fields (SOW reference, cost center)?
- Invoice cadence: we prefer one consolidated invoice monthly (single statement across multiple lines). Is that possible if we consume both hosted API and a short Dedicated trial?
- Net terms: BlueWell standard is Net 45. Would Redwood accept Net 45 or do you require Net 30 for new enterprise customers?
- Discounts: we have an internal policy that requires discounts to be visible on each invoice line. We may ask for a small prepay discount if we commit to an annual minimum.

Attached is our PO template for reference (procurement asked we send to the vendor). Can you review and confirm whether this will work and what fields you need returned on the invoice?

Amy
Amy Lopez
Sr. Procurement Manager | BlueWell Health
amy.lopez@bluewellhealth.com
Attachment: BlueWell_PO_Template.pdf (pdf)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amy Lopez <amy.lopez@bluewellhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO template + billing cadence for Redwood pilot

Thanks Amy — really appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front: we can accept your PO template, support consolidated monthly billing, and can do Net 45 for the pilot with a slight conditions note. Details below.

On the PO fields:
- Required: PO Number, PO Date, Bill-to (your billing contact), Remit-to (Redwood billing address + Redwood tax ID).
- Optional but helpful: SOW reference (we map lines to the SOW in our billing system) and BlueWell cost center (for internal allocation).

Invoice cadence and consolidation:
- We can produce one consolidated monthly statement that contains line items for Hosted API usage and any Dedicated trial consumption. Each invoice line will include the SKU, quantity, unit price, and any line-level discount (per your requirement).

Net terms & penalty language:
- We can accept Net 45 for this engagement. For multi-month commitments or annual prepay discounts we typically require Net 30, but we will make a Net 45 exception for a 6-month pilot.
- Note: standard terms say late payments incur a 1.5% monthly interest after 60 days. If BlueWell needs a hard waiver of interest, that requires escalation.

Discounts & packaging:
- If you commit to an annual minimum spend (we can draft a minimum commitment schedule), we can offer a 7% prepay discount. For pilot pricing we can offer a 5% line-item discount (applies to invoice lines clearly marked in the PO/SOW). Discounts will be shown on each invoice line per your procurement policy.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm which billing address and cost-center to appear on the PO?
2) Please return the filled PO template and we will attach a Redwood SOW referencing the SKUs.
3) Vanessa (cc'd) will follow up on G/L coding and will attach our vendor remit details.

I'll attach the SOW draft for your review.

Best,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: procurement@bluewellhealth.com
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amy Lopez <amy.lopez@bluewellhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO template + billing cadence for Redwood pilot

Mina — thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications from procurement:

- Billing address: BlueWell Health / AP Dept / 300 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105.
- Cost center: 44-ClinicalAI (please put on the invoice as 'CostCenter: 44-ClinicalAI').
- We will need line-level discounts and a separate field for the vendor tax ID on the invoice so our ERP can map VAT/exempt status.
- Regarding the late fee: our legal will not approve additional waiver language. We can accept the standard 1.5% only if Redwood agrees to notify us 30 days prior to applying any fee and allow a 10-day cure period.

We attached the completed PO template. Can you confirm Redwood's remit address and vendor tax ID so we can populate the final PO?

Procurement Team
BlueWell Health

- Can Redwood provide consolidated monthly invoices in both PDF and machine-readable CSV so we can ingest into our accounting system?
- We will sign off on Net 45 for the pilot; however, for the annual commitment we would prefer a Net 60 term in exchange for a larger prepay discount. Would Redwood consider Net 60 for a prepaid arrangement?

Also attaching the signed PO (filled) — please confirm Redwood's acceptance and provide a written invoice schedule (dates) so I can calendar the first payment.

Amy

Amy / Procurement — thanks, all accepted. Finalizing below so we have a single source of truth: 

1) PO accepted: Redwood confirms receipt of your signed PO template. Redwood's remit & tax ID (as Vanessa listed) have been added to our system; PO Number BW-PO-20260916-45 will be attached to all invoices.
2) Invoice cadence: Consolidated monthly invoice sent on the 5th business day following month close. Each invoice will include a PDF (human-readable) and an attached CSV export with line-level GLCode and CostCenter fields.
3) Net terms: Net 45 for the pilot (invoice due 45 days from invoice date). For any annual prepay commitment, Redwood will evaluate Net 60 requests on a case-by-case basis; we can confirm in the commercial amendment.
4) Discounts: Pilot will carry the 5% line-item discount; annual-prepay discount (7%) to be documented in the amendment. Discounts will be line-item fields on the invoice.
5) Late fee procedure: Redwood agrees to your process: 30-day notice + 10-day cure before any interest is applied. Interest rate will remain Redwood standard 1.5% per month thereafter.

Next operational step: Vanessa will send a vendor onboarding packet and the first invoice schedule (pdf + csv template) to ar@bluewellhealth.com by end of day tomorrow. Vivek — I'll loop you in for a short kickoff to wire the SOW to usage SKUs.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot live.

Mina
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
